findings.claim: The topbar brand exposes the KnowMe name twice to assistive technology because the link is labelled and its child lockup is also a named image.
findings.evidence: brand-identity requirement says every brand rendering SHALL expose the name "KnowMe" exactly once; topbar.tsx adds `<Link to="/" aria-label="KnowMe home"> <KnowMeLockup variant="nav" />`, while knowme-lockup.tsx renders `<span role="img" aria-label="KnowMe">`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the link aria-label and let the lockup provide the link name, or add a decorative/aria-hidden mode to KnowMeLockup when it is inside an explicitly labelled link.
